sourceRoot: Directory containing index.ts, config.ts, tokens.css, components.css and ai/. All paths in this registry resolve from that directory; preserve ai/ when relocating it.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: Pixels. No runtime validation/clamp; use a finite nonnegative value. 0–16 is the workbench range, not a type/API restriction.

fields.name: reducedMotion
fields.note: true additionally reduces motion; false never overrides OS prefers-reduced-motion.

components.purpose: Expandable agent-task execution rows with application-supplied states, capsules or connected list.
components.inheritedProps: Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<ul>, children>. Native attributes/ref/events are forwarded to the ul; label supplies aria-label.
components.state: Execution state is always application-owned. Internal expansion starts from defaultExpandedIds; expandedIds/onExpandedChange controls multiple rows. Disclosure never alters execution.
accessibility: Native named ul, stable keyed rows; native disclosure buttons with aria-expanded, aria-controls and labeled panels. Title/summary are noninteractive strings. Detail actions are outside triggers.

Visible translated state text plus decorative number/spinner/check/error. Hidden panels are hidden/inert immediately while retained DOM preserves detail values. Controlled collapse returns panel focus to its trigger without stealing outside focus. State updates retain focus and expansion.
limitations: Supply stable unique nonempty IDs. No agent runtime, networking, library timers, automatic progression, sorting or persistence.
No completion checklist, assignees, ToolCall or ToolChips. The labeled example alone owns Run/Replay/retry timers and guards/cancels older runs on replay/unmount.

components.purpose: Compact application-owned notifications with explicit read controls and a derived unread count.

props.name: labels
props.type: { unread: string; read: string; markRead: string; markAllRead: string }
props.note: Defaults follow direction; count digits follow direction.

components.inheritedProps: Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<div>, children>. Native attributes/ref/events target the root div; contains a named native ul.
components.state: Application owns supplied read state, order and filtering. Count derives only from supplied items. Opening actions never marks read. Optional callbacks report requests only.
accessibility: Visible unread text and decorative dot; read text remains understandable without color. Valid supplied dateTime renders time; otherwise plain timestamp.

Per-item controls stay mounted and become aria-disabled after read, preserving focus in All. Mark all disables at zero. The application recovers focus when filtering removes a row; bundled example uses the next remaining mark-read control (previous when last), then selected filter.
limitations: Supply unique stable nonempty IDs. No dismiss, polling, push permissions, backend or persistence. Filtering and removal focus belong to the host.
Distinguish no notifications from no unread notifications with application emptyState. icon is decorative; caller owns avatar semantics.

components.inheritedProps: Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<ol>, children>. Native list attributes/events, className/style and ref are preserved; label supplies aria-label and ordered list semantics are retained with role=list.
components.purpose: Application-owned process progress with static display by default and opt-in button activation.

props.name: currentId
props.note: Overrides current statuses, including a current error. Unmatched ID means no current step; otherwise only the first current status is marked.

props.name: onStepActivate
props.note: Opts into type=button for every step. No automatic state change or eligibility rule.

props.name: statusLabels
props.note: Translated accessible status text; defaults to locale.

components.state: Controlled display only. The application owns items, currentId, validation, eligibility and progress.
accessibility: Native ordered list with stable unique IDs. One aria-current=step on the current list item or activation button. Decorative number/check/error indicators plus accessible status text. Native Enter/Space buttons only when onStepActivate is supplied.
Logical horizontal order follows direction. Narrow containers/screens become vertical. Connectors align to indicators independently of multiline content. No trailing connector.
Labels/descriptions are noninteractive inline content. onStepActivate creates buttons for all items; callers must enforce any eligibility in their callback.
limitations: No navigation, validation engine, automatic advancement or persistence. No built-in disabled-step API. Supply unique nonempty IDs and meaningful labels. Additional current statuses remain supplied state text; only the first is marked current.

components.inheritedProps: Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<ol>, children>. Native list attributes/events, className/style and ref are preserved; label supplies aria-label and ordered list semantics are retained with role=list.
components.purpose: Chronological application event list in exactly the supplied order.
accessibility: Native ordered list with stable unique IDs, logical connector and no trailing rail. RTL changes layout only; supplied order is preserved.

Timestamp uses time with dateTime when supplied. The application must provide valid machine-readable dates and formatted timestamp text in its chosen locale/time zone. Without dateTime, plain text is rendered.
Icons are decorative; essential meaning belongs in title. Isolate mixed-direction IDs with bdi. Application content/actions retain native semantics.
limitations: No fetching, sorting, virtualization, grouping, relative-time timers or persistence. Supply stable unique nonempty IDs. Long content wraps; content components must support their available width.

providers: SystemProvider for tokens, direction and scoped overlay container.
components.purpose: Native single range.
components.useWhen: One bounded numeric choice.
components.alternative: Use Input for free text; application owns validation and persistence.
components.inheritedProps: Native input attributes/ref/events, excluding fixed input presentation props; inspect exported type. label/helper/error and field are mutually exclusive. onChange observes normalized text for OTPInput; Slider onChange observes native event. Preventing default cancels onValueChange.
components.state: Native single range. Clamp/snap to min-based steps; round decimal noise to 15 significant digits; largest reachable step never exceeds max. Default value is range midpoint. Nonfinite bounds use defaults; max below min becomes min; nonfinite/nonpositive step uses 1. Controlled value is authoritative; defaultValue initializes once. formatValue adds readout and aria-valuetext, submission stays numeric.
events: onValueChange reports user changes only. Uncontrolled uncanceled form reset restores initial defaultValue without callback; controlled form reset requires application onReset. Reset follows current/external form and respects preventDefault.
accessibility: Label/helper/error reuse Field and merge external associations. Standalone controls need an accessible name. Disabled omits native form submission.
Native focus, selection and keyboard behavior; no custom gesture engine.
limitations: No range, marks editor or custom pointer/keyboard engine. Native horizontal arrows follow direction; test target browsers.

providers: SystemProvider for tokens, direction and scoped overlay container.
components.purpose: One real text input; decorative slots hidden from accessibility tree.
components.useWhen: A fixed-length digit code, without verification behavior.
components.alternative: Use Input for free text; application owns validation and persistence.
components.inheritedProps: Native input attributes/ref/events, excluding fixed input presentation props; inspect exported type. label/helper/error and field are mutually exclusive. onChange observes normalized text for OTPInput; Slider onChange observes native event. Preventing default cancels onValueChange.
components.state: One real text input; decorative slots hidden from accessibility tree. Native selection/editing/paste preserved, with one-to-one Arabic/Eastern Arabic digit normalization to ASCII. Strip nondigits and truncate to length; leading zeros and partial values preserved. length floors/clamps 1–12, nonfinite uses 6. Code order LTR. autocomplete=one-time-code and inputMode=numeric. No complete callback or side effects. Digits/static caret paint once in aria-hidden grid cells centered with CSS grid, without letter-spacing offsets. Transparent native input owns all editing and actual selection. Only the active slot has focus outline; native ranges shade selected cells; error borders remain independent. Click selects caret before the slot digit, clamped to current text end; Shift-click/drag map actual native selection. Forward range active slot is end-1, backward is start; a full end caret stays within last slot.
events: onValueChange reports user changes only. Uncontrolled uncanceled form reset restores initial defaultValue without callback; controlled form reset requires application onReset. Reset follows current/external form and respects preventDefault.
accessibility: Label/helper/error reuse Field and merge external associations. Standalone controls need an accessible name. Disabled omits native form submission.
Native focus, selection and keyboard behavior; no custom gesture engine.
limitations: Native pattern requires complete length during form validation; empty allowed unless required. Partial values are still represented/submitted if validation is bypassed. No verification, focus handoff, autosubmit, resend or SMS. Actual device autofill needs device testing.

providers: SystemProvider for tokens, direction and scoped overlay container.
components.purpose: Single Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD or empty string.
components.useWhen: A single date-only Gregorian selection.
components.alternative: Use Input for free text; application owns validation and persistence.
components.inheritedProps: Native button attributes/ref/events except value/defaultValue/type/children/onChange; name/form belong to hidden submission input.
components.state: Single Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD or empty string. Parse/format local year/month/day without UTC conversions, years 0001–9999. Inclusive min/max; invalid bounds ignored. Invalid value props display feedback and submit empty. Valid out-of-bounds caller values stay visible/submitted with feedback; calendar cannot select outside. locale independent of direction; Gregorian display with localized numbers. Today and Clear, previous/next month. DayPicker owns keyboard calendar navigation; Radix Popover owns viewport positioning, dismissal and focus restoration using nearest SystemProvider/Sheet/Modal container. Month select/year menu navigate without changing selection. Year menu shows at most five rows with scrolling through all choices, using existing Radix Select 2.4.1. yearRange configures direct year choices only (default viewed year ±100); includes the viewed year and does not constrain date validity. Only min/max bound navigation. Primitive around layout owns RTL chevrons.
events: onValueChange reports user changes only. Uncontrolled uncanceled form reset restores initial defaultValue without callback; controlled form reset requires application onReset. Reset follows current/external form and respects preventDefault.
accessibility: Label/helper/error reuse Field and merge external associations. Standalone controls need an accessible name. Disabled omits native form submission.
DatePicker selected display is part of the trigger name; popup uses localized names and scopes inside dialogs.
Native htmlFor/implicit labels preserve native naming; selected date is aria-describedby. Field/explicit ARIA modes include visible date/placeholder in the accessible name.
limitations: Application owns form validation: hidden submission has no native required/pattern constraints. No ranges, time, Hijri, manual date text entry or calendar framework. Install @daypicker/react 10.0.2 and @radix-ui/react-popover 1.3.1. Preserve shared Radix overrides in ai/README.md.

providers: SystemProvider for shared tokens and direction.
components.purpose: Select local files without upload infrastructure.
components.useWhen: Accessible browsing and drag/drop with one selection list.
components.alternative: Use native input for an unenhanced picker; application supplies uploads.
components.inheritedProps: Native file input props/ref/events except type/value/defaultValue/children/size/name/required/readOnly. Props and ref target hidden native input. label/helper/error or field are mutually exclusive. Native input is cleared after each browse change; onChange can inspect the raw FileList before it is cleared.
components.state: Controlled value is authoritative; defaultValue initializes internal selection once. Multiple appends; single replaces with first valid file. Same type/size/count/duplicate checks for browse/drop. Accepted files survive partial rejection; total rejection preserves previous selection. Duplicate identity is exact name,size,type,lastModified, including within a batch; ignore and explain. Removal allows reselection and focuses browse button. Finite maxFiles floors/clamps to zero, finite maxFileSize clamps to zero bytes; nonfinite means no cap.
events: onValueChange reports user additions/removals, never reset. onChange observes only native browsing. labels supports browse/drop/remove(file)/rejected(file,reason), where reason is type|size|count|duplicate.
accessibility: Use label or separate Field; standalone requires native/ARIA name. Helper/error/external descriptions merge. Native Browse button supports keyboard; removal returns focus to Browse. One outer focus ring on drop area. Nested drag depth prevents flicker. Filename wraps using bdi. Disabled prevents all user changes.
limitations: No native name/required selected-array submission. Construct application FormData from the selected File[]; cleared native input does not represent selected files. Uncontrolled uncanceled reset restores initial defaultValue without callback; controlled reset needs application onReset. Reset follows current/external form and clears feedback.

Client accept/type/size checks are convenience checks, not security or server validation. MIME may be missing or unreliable. No networking, upload success/progress, storage, image previews or directory uploads.

providers: SystemProvider for shared tokens and direction.
components.purpose: Choose an opaque RGB color using presets, HEX and a native chooser.
components.useWhen: A local application color value, independent of system accent configuration.
components.alternative: Application-owned advanced picker for alpha or other color spaces.
components.inheritedProps: Native HEX text input attributes/ref/events except value/defaultValue/type/children/size/readOnly. name submits a separate hidden committed value. label/helper/error and field are mutually exclusive. Native chooser has a translated name; no separate ref API.
components.state: Opaque #RGB/#RRGGBB only, trim and normalize commits to uppercase #RRGGBB. Incomplete text remains while editing. Enter/blur commits valid input; invalid text retains draft, announces feedback and does not change selected color. Swatches and native chooser commit immediately and synchronize draft. Controlled value is authoritative and parent must update; invalid value/defaultValue props fall back to #316746. Invalid swatch values are omitted.
events: onValueChange reports a changed committed color, not draft edits/reset. Native onChange reports HEX text editing. labels translates chooser/swatches/invalid.
accessibility: Field associations and external descriptions merge on LTR HEX input. Named preset buttons use aria-pressed and a visible check mark; focus ring is distinct from selection. Native chooser and HEX share one focus treatment. Disabled disables every control and omits hidden value.
limitations: name/form submit the committed color, never incomplete/invalid draft. Application owns validation; local invalid feedback is not itself a submission blocker. Caller-supplied native HEX constraints such as required/pattern still apply. Uncontrolled uncanceled reset restores initial normalized defaultValue and clears draft/feedback without callback; controlled reset requires application onReset.
Native chooser appearance/browser interaction varies. No alpha, saturation/hue canvas, eyedropper or system-accent configuration.

providers: SystemProvider for shared direction, theme, accent, density, typography, corners and reduced motion.
components.purpose: Enter a string array with native text editing.
components.useWhen: Several free-text tags in one labeled field.
components.alternative: Input for one string; Select for a predefined single choice.
components.inheritedProps: Native input attributes/ref/events except value/defaultValue/type/children/size/required. label/helper/error or field are mutually exclusive; helper/error require label. Draft is internal; onChange observes native draft editing. name/form associate repeated hidden committed tag entries, never the draft.
components.state: value/onValueChange controls the array; omit value for internal state initialized once by defaultValue. Enter trims candidate and rejects empty/exact case-sensitive duplicates. maxTags finite floors/clamps to zero; nonfinite means no cap. Externally supplied arrays are authoritative and never silently normalized or truncated.
events: onValueChange only for user add/remove, not reset. Native input events preserve editing and may prevent default keyboard behavior.
accessibility: Field helper/error and external description IDs are merged; supply standalone native/ARIA label when omitting label.

IME composition Enter is ignored. Empty Backspace removes the last tag; remove buttons focus the text input. Disabled/readOnly prevent changes. labels can translate remove(tag), duplicate and maximum(count); defaults follow direction.

Draft focus is shown once on the rounded container, matching Input outline width/offset. Only while the outer ring is present is the inner draft outline/shadow suppressed. Remove actions retain separate native keyboard rings; invalid border and focus ring coexist.
limitations: No autocomplete, bulk paste parsing, validation engine or required tag API.

Submission uses repeated hidden name entries; disabled tags omitted, read-only tags included, draft omitted. Uncontrolled reset restores initial defaultValue without callback after respecting cancellation; controlled arrays need application onReset. Unconfirmed draft and feedback clear on uncanceled reset.

providers: SystemProvider for shared direction, theme, accent, density, typography, corners and reduced motion.
components.purpose: Compose search controls and removable active filters.
components.useWhen: Controls above an application-owned list or table.
components.alternative: Input/Select/Button separately when active filter chips are not needed.
components.inheritedProps: Native div attributes/ref except aria-label. Root role=group; label supplies its accessible name. search is a ReactNode slot and children is a controls slot; reuse existing control APIs. FilterBarFilter: required unique stable id:string, label:string, removeLabel:string, onRemove:()=>void.
components.state: Application owns filters, search, filtering, result counts and reset logic. filters defaults empty. Optional Clear all renders only while filters exist; clearLabel defaults by provider direction. disabled prevents removal/Clear only; application disables composed controls.
accessibility: Chips have explicit remove names, labels wrap and controls wrap responsively. Focus moves to next remove action, first available control or root group before removal. Clear all returns focus to a control/group.
limitations: No filtering engine, data fetching, persistence, control API duplication or toolbar keyboard model.

providers: SystemProvider for shared direction, theme, accent, density, typography, corners and reduced motion.
components.purpose: Read-only selectable value with an internal copy button at logical end.
components.useWhen: Copy paths, identifiers or links the application actually provides.
components.alternative: Input for editable text.
components.inheritedProps: Native input props/ref except value/defaultValue/type/children/size/readOnly/onChange. Always read-only. label/helper/error convenience mode is mutually exclusive with field; helper/error require label. Ref, name/form, selection events, className/style target input.
components.state: Success only after navigator.clipboard.writeText resolves: a check icon for two seconds and a visually hidden polite announcement, no visible success text/row. Rejection/unavailable clipboard retains persistent visible manual-copy guidance. Value replacement/unmount invalidate pending results and clear timers/feedback. No synthetic success. Pending writes retain keyboard focus: the wrapper is aria-busy, the button is aria-disabled rather than natively disabled, and repeated activation is ignored. External disabled still uses native disabled on input and button.
accessibility: Native selectable input remains usable for manual copying. Field associations match Input. Supply an accessible input name in standalone mode and labels.copy for a context-specific action. labels.copied/failure translate status; defaults follow direction.
Copy is a real button inside the input boundary: right in LTR, left in RTL. Input padding reserves the button area; native keyboard focus stays visible and success does not change control geometry.
limitations: Clipboard availability/permission belongs to browser; no deprecated execCommand fallback or automatic permission flow.

components.purpose: Compact composable navigation surface with expanded and icon rail states.
components.useWhen: Persistent desktop navigation or the same content composed inside an existing Sheet on mobile.
components.alternative: Use native links for destinations, SidebarAction for commands and SidebarDisclosure for one level of children. Sheet supplies mobile modality.
components.inheritedProps: Sidebar accepts native aside props/ref. SidebarHeader/Footer native div, SidebarContent native nav (supply aria-label), SidebarLabel native span. SidebarGroup native div plus optional heading:string. SidebarItem native anchor excluding children plus required label:string, icon:ReactNode, optional count:string|number, active:boolean=false; real href supplied by caller. SidebarAction native button excluding children plus label, icon, count. SidebarToggle native button plus required collapseLabel/expandLabel strings. SidebarDisclosure native button excluding children plus required label/icon/children, optional count, activeChild=false, open/defaultOpen=false/onOpenChange. All native attributes/events/ref/className/style remain on the underlying element. Buttons default type=button. Preventing default in click cancels built-in toggle/disclosure behavior. SidebarIdentity is a native div/ref for icon/avatar + SidebarLabel composition; header aligns identity/toggle in a row, then stacks them in the rail. Footer identity centers the actual avatar box in the rail.
components.state: collapsed/onCollapsedChange controls root; omission initializes internal state from defaultCollapsed once. Disclosure open/onOpenChange or internal defaultOpen. Rail disclosure requests root expansion and opens children. Both controlled callbacks must update caller state. Previously open children reappear when root expands. activeChild is explicit caller state, not inferred from routing or DOM.
accessibility: Native links preserve browser destination/modifier behavior; required label supplies accessible name independent of hidden text. Counts and icons are decorative; include essential count meaning in an explicit aria-label if needed. Existing Tooltip supplies rail labels.

Collapse/disclosure hides children with hidden/inert. Focus moves from hidden descendants to their disclosure parent, otherwise a visible toggle/item. Wrap slot text in SidebarLabel; hidden labels are inert. Keep essential actions as SidebarAction.

Logical indentation and chevrons mirror direction. Header/footer persist while SidebarContent scrolls; host supplies bounded height and inline-start placement. Both OS and application reduced motion suppress transitions.
Reuse the same content in Sheet on mobile. Keep trigger mounted; hand destination focus after trigger restoration. Escape/outside dismissal restores trigger.

Collapsed navigation hides group heading space and its visual scrollbar without disabling native keyboard/wheel scrolling; all rail boxes share the same axis. Header layout mirrors through native direction.
limitations: One disclosure level supported. No routing, permission, workspace switching, shell, mobile overlay or persistence framework.
Give every interactive rail item an icon. Host positions Sidebar on the right for RTL, left for LTR. Header/footer are arbitrary composition slots; use SidebarLabel to hide text.
Counts truncate visually and do not convey essential meaning on their own.

components.purpose: Perform an explicit action.
components.useWhen: Save, submit, create, or open an overlay.
components.alternative: Use Switch for a persistent boolean setting; Tabs for related views.

props.name: state
props.note: Caller-owned state; no automatic loading/feedback lifecycle. Loading disables activation and sets aria-busy; success/error do not disable the button.

props.name: iconOnly
props.note: When true, aria-label is required by ButtonProps; provide a nonempty accessible name.

props.name: aria-label
props.note: Required when iconOnly=true, optional otherwise. Not forwarded via the ordinary inherited base; reintroduced by the conditional union.

props.name: children
props.note: Visible meaningful action label, or one decorative icon in iconOnly idle state. State icons replace icon-only children outside idle.

components.inheritedProps: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> except aria-label, which is reintroduced conditionally. Native form attributes, id, style, event handlers, ARIA/data attributes are accepted; className is appended. No ref prop in ButtonProps.
exclusions: No asChild or href/link API. Caller aria-busy is overridden by state; internal data-state/data-variant/data-size and className are owned by the wrapper.
components.state: state is fully caller-controlled; disabled is also forced while loading.
events: onClick and native button events; connect actions to application logic.
accessibility: Icon-only needs aria-label. Use descriptive visible text otherwise. Decorative icons should be aria-hidden. Set type=submit explicitly for submission.
limitations: No built-in async operation, persistence, retry or automatic transition back to idle.
providers: SystemProvider for styling/configuration; Button itself reads CSS tokens.

components.purpose: Switch between related content panels.
components.useWhen: Related dashboard views under one meaningful group label.
components.alternative: Use DropdownMenu for commands; navigation links for unrelated routes (not supplied).

props.name: items
props.note: Unique nonempty values; supply at least one enabled item and valid active value.

props.name: label
props.note: Nonempty accessible name for the tablist.

props.name: value
props.note: Controlled active value; pair with onValueChange updating caller state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.note: Initial uncontrolled value; later defaultValue changes do not reset local selection.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond TabsProps. Radix Root/List/Trigger/Content props are not spread through this wrapper.
exclusions: No orientation, activationMode, asChild, forceMount, id or arbitrary native/Radix prop passthrough.
components.state: value controls selection; otherwise internal state initializes from defaultValue or first enabled item.
events: onValueChange receives selected value; local state also updates.
accessibility: Required label; each item label is a meaningful ReactNode. Radix supplies roles, keyboard navigation, disabled behavior and panel linkage. Test direction-aware arrows and focus.
limitations: Horizontal only, Radix default automatic activation; no routing, lazy data loading, or library enforcement of unique/valid values.
providers: SystemProvider provides direction, density and scoped CSS.

components.purpose: Change a persistent two-state setting.
components.useWhen: Immediate enabled/disabled preference.
components.alternative: Use Button for a command; use Tiraz Checkbox for a form choice.

props.name: label
props.note: Nonempty visible label associated with generated or caller id.

props.name: checked
props.note: Controlled; pair with onCheckedChange.

props.name: className
props.note: Applied to outer field wrapper; style and inherited native props target the Radix button.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.note: Merged with the generated description id, not replaced.

components.inheritedProps: ComponentProps<typeof Radix Switch.Root> minus children/asChild; includes native button/form attributes, style, ARIA/data attributes, events and ref to the button. Consult installed Radix type definitions for the full inherited set.
exclusions: children and asChild excluded; wrapper owns Thumb and label/help markup.
components.state: checked/onCheckedChange controls state; defaultChecked initializes Radix internal state otherwise.
events: onCheckedChange receives boolean, plus inherited native events.
accessibility: Use visible label, unique id if supplied, and description for supporting text. Space toggles. Native required/name/value/form are inherited.
limitations: Not a custom content slot; inspector choices/allowed attributes do not restrict the public inherited API.
providers: SystemProvider for shared CSS tokens.

components.purpose: Present contextual commands.
components.useWhen: Several actions behind a focusable trigger.
components.alternative: Use Select for choosing one form value; Tabs for related views.

props.name: trigger
props.note: Single focusable trigger accepting injected Radix props/ref. Tiraz Button works; arbitrary custom triggers must forward them.

props.name: items
props.note: Unique ids and meaningful labels; callbacks are per item.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond DropdownMenuProps. Trigger uses Radix asChild; props configured on the trigger element remain its own API.
exclusions: No defaultOpen, modal, side, collision settings, content className, arbitrary native props or Radix submenu/checkbox/radio item API.
components.state: open controls visibility when supplied; otherwise local state starts false. Pair controlled open with onOpenChange updating caller.
events: onOpenChange; MenuItem.onSelect() invokes application action (no event argument in public type).
accessibility: Name trigger and all commands. Arrow keys, Home/End, typeahead, Enter, Escape and Tab dismissal are supported; focus returns to trigger. Preserve early-opening keyboard focus and real hover.
limitations: Nonmodal menu; no nested submenus. Shortcut text is decorative and registers no shortcut. Long content scrolls within available viewport height.
providers: SystemProvider supplies direction and portal container; nested menus inside Sheet portal into Sheet content to remain within modal focus scope.

components.purpose: Show modal details or a focused editing task.
components.useWhen: A detail view or small form without leaving the dashboard.
components.alternative: Use DropdownMenu for a short command list; ordinary inline content for nonmodal tasks.

props.name: trigger
props.note: Single focusable element accepting injected Radix props/ref.

props.name: title
props.note: Meaningful dialog title.

props.name: description
props.note: Meaningful dialog description; do not omit or pass an empty string just to satisfy the type.

props.name: closeLabel
props.note: Nonempty accessible name for close icon.

props.name: side
props.default: right in RTL, left in LTR

components.inheritedProps: None beyond SheetProps. Radix Dialog props are curated, not spread.
exclusions: No defaultOpen, modal=false, asChild, content className, native attrs or custom focus-event passthrough.
components.state: open/onOpenChange controls visibility; otherwise Radix internal state starts closed. Draft save/cancel semantics belong to the application.
events: onOpenChange for trigger, Escape, backdrop or close dismissal.
accessibility: Required title, description and closeLabel; modal focus management, Escape dismissal and trigger restoration. Keep nested actions within Sheet scope.
limitations: Modal only; width is styled by library CSS. No built-in form validation, data persistence or dirty-dismiss confirmation.
An active Toast can receive Escape first; do not assume every Escape closes this Sheet.
providers: SystemProvider config/portal container; Sheet supplies descendants the current config with its content as portal container.

components.purpose: Announce transient success/error/info feedback.
components.useWhen: Outcome of a completed action; secondary information.
components.alternative: Use persistent inline text for essential errors/instructions, Sheet for a decision needing action. No Alert/Dialog family is supplied.

props.name: label
props.note: Localized notification/viewport label used by Radix.

props.name: closeLabel
props.note: Nonempty localized accessible close name.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond the three provider props. ToastMessage controls individual notices.
exclusions: No public Toast component, open/onOpenChange, provider duration prop, arbitrary Radix attrs or action slot.
components.state: useToast().toast(message) adds an internally managed notice; automatic/manual dismissal. At most three active messages; older active messages are dropped, not queued indefinitely.
events: toast(message): void; message fields described in records.
accessibility: useToast must run in a descendant of ToastProvider (not in the same component before it returns the provider); outside it throws. Place ToastProvider inside SystemProvider. Keep important feedback available persistently too; inspect announcements manually.
limitations: Default duration 5000 ms, info tone; hover/focus pauses expiry. F8 viewport navigation, manual close and down swipe supported. Scoped inline viewport, not a global portal. No guarantee that automated checks prove accessibility.
An active Toast participates in Radix dismissable-layer ordering: Escape can dismiss it before a Sheet even when focus is inside the Sheet. Check layer dismissal and restoration separately.
providers: SystemProvider for styling/config; ToastProvider for useToast callers.

accessibility: Label htmlFor and aria-labelledby target field.id; helper/error and external description IDs are merged. required forwards the constraint and shows a decorative indicator.
limitations: Required indication/error display do not validate application rules.
providers: SystemProvider for shared styling and configuration.
components.purpose: Lower-level label/helper/error composition for one Input, Select, Textarea, TagInput or InputCopy; documented under Input and still publicly exported.
components.useWhen: Label an Input or Select with persistent application validation feedback.
components.alternative: Standalone Input/Select accepts external native labels or ARIA naming.

props.name: error
props.note: Display only. Application owns validation; nonempty error marks the composed control invalid.

components.inheritedProps: None beyond FieldProps. Render one control using field={control}.
exclusions: No arbitrary-child cloning, validation rules, nested fields or form state management.
components.state: Application supplies error; Field generates stable association IDs. Lower-level composition helper documented under Input, with no standalone navigation item. Existing export and API remain supported.

events: onChange receives React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>; other native input events.
accessibility: Start with Input label for accessible labeled text entry; internal Field supplies required indicator and stable helper/error associations. Without label, name the standalone input with a native label or ARIA. Existing field composition remains available, mutually exclusive with convenience mode.
External aria-describedby IDs are preserved and deduplicated. Error text marks invalid without application validation rules. Ref/className/style target the actual input.
limitations: Application owns validation messages/rules and controlled reset.
providers: SystemProvider for shared styling and configuration.
components.purpose: Native text entry with optional label, helper and error text.
components.useWhen: Short customer names, emails and other single-line text.

Sidebar accepts native aside props/ref. SidebarHeader/Footer native div, SidebarContent native nav (supply aria-label), SidebarLabel native span. SidebarGroup native div plus optional heading:string. SidebarItem native anchor excluding children plus required label:string, icon:ReactNode, optional count:string|number, active:boolean=false; real href supplied by caller. SidebarAction native button excluding children plus label, icon, count. SidebarToggle native button plus required collapseLabel/expandLabel strings. All native attributes/events/ref/className/style remain on the underlying element. Buttons default type=button. Preventing default in click cancels built-in toggle/disclosure behavior. SidebarIdentity is a native div/ref for icon/avatar + SidebarLabel composition; header aligns identity/toggle in a row, then stacks them in the rail.
